title: After the FDA spent years rejecting over flavored vape products, Trump reportedly pressed his FDA commissioner to allow mango and blueberry flavors

summary: Reports suggest that Donald Trump allegedly pressured the FDA commissioner to allow the sale of flavored vape products, specifically mango and blueberry flavors, following years where the FDA had rejected numerous flavored options. title: Magnum owns Ben & Jerry’s. Now it’s destroying what made the brand worth buying
teaser: Dr. Bronner's boasts a $100M+ charity track record, while Patagonia shifts to a nonprofit trust.
summary: Major brands are undergoing significant structural changes: Dr. Bronner's has dedicated over $100 million to social/environmental causes while maintaining fair trade standards. Separately, Patagonia, led by Ryan Gellert since 2020, has transferred its ownership to a perpetual purpose trust and nonprofit organization. These moves highlight a growing trend toward integrating social and environmental governance into consumer brands.
